question: In which of the following years was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is option __1929.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Child Marriage Restraint Act was passed on 28th September 1929, to eradicate the evil of Child Marriage.
 
• It came into force on 1st April 1930.
 
• It is popularly known as Sarda Act.
 
• It made child marriage a Punishable and cognizable offense.
 
• Under the Act, the minimum age for a girl’s marriage was set to 14 years, and that for boys was fixed at 18 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Act was amended in 1978 post-independence, in order to increase the age limit. The age limit was increased to 18 years for girls and 21 years for boys.
 
• The Act still failed to be proven effective in restraining child marriages in India. One of the major reasons was the punishment under the Act.
 
• In order to bring reforms under the law, the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 was enacted, with increased punishment for the offenders.
 
• The new Child Marriage Amendment bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 20th December 2021. The primary objective of this bill is to raise the legal marriage age for females from 18 to 21 in India.
 
• The justification behind this amendment is the enforcement of the Constitutional mandate of gender equality as the legal marriage age for males in India is 21.
